motivation: The completed module branch confounded fewer AE layers with fixed D2. A separate branch could trade action-expert depth against Euler time resolution, using actual completed-policy cost matching rather than layer counts.

proposal_basis.known_result: AE16D2=74/80, AE14D2=64/80, AE12D2=24/80; no complementary pair. These known outcomes motivate D3/D4 compensation; improvement is not assumed.

numeric_requirements: Unwrapped original adapter D2/D3/D4/D10 vs scoped AE18 parity on four fixed-bank prompts at unchanged1e-5; actual AE visits, exact exported Euler nodes, restoration, reset and every-request native counters; preserve original sampler and kernel sources.
reference_requirements: If old Full/AE16D2 quality records are reused, keep their identities and first-input/noise contracts; first reproduce four known controls per algorithm bitwise in the new runtime. Otherwise do not reuse.
qualification: Before GPU outcomes freeze complete-data selection: overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15, native cost ratio>=1.15, pair cost within10%, opposite distinct-suite gaps>=.10, >=2 positive tasks, each task LOO positive. Logical AE visits do not establish equal latency.
